name: Cheeding Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未公布任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约公告，所发布的公告主要为季度业绩、年度报告、股东大会及股息除权安排。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any expansion, new business, reduction, disposal, or contract for its business segments; announcements were mainly quarterly results, annual report, general meetings, and dividend book closure arrangements.
